metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — small, org-neutral developer-experience tools

plugins.name: english-coach
plugins.description: Non-blocking English coaching on every prompt: flags natural-language mistakes (articles, prepositions, false friends, tense, word-order calques), remembers recurring ones in a local per-user ledger, and posts a short hint as soon as it's ready via a background wake — even mid-idle. Never blocks or slows a turn.

plugins.name: render
plugins.description: On-demand, fully-offline Mermaid rendering: the /render command wraps a bundled script that turns a mermaid block into a self-contained HTML file and prints a file:// URL. Nothing leaves the machine — no CDN at render time, no third-party live editor — so it is safe for diagrams that encode sensitive detail. Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, WSL, Windows).
